extDescription.message: Speed, quality and volume for the active tab's video. On live streams it reduces delay without fighting the player.

cannotConnect.message: Could not connect. Reload the tab.

cannotOpenExperimental.message: Could not open the experimental picker.

pageNoResponse.message: The page did not respond. Reload the tab.

capTitleKick.message: Highest quality offered by this stream (Kick has no plans).

capTitleGeneric.message: Actual session ceiling: the highest quality the player can reach with this account and device.

siteReverted.message: The site reverted the speed; control was released.

reaffirming.message: The site set another value; reasserting.

liveEdge.message: At the live edge: 1× until the delay grows.

blockedOne.message: The site tried to change it $1 time; blocked.

blockedMany.message: The site tried to change it $1 times; blocked.

noBuffer.message: Not enough buffer. Wait a moment.

busyFallback.message: Another extension is capturing this tab.

captureBusy.message: This tab is already being captured by another extension (for example Volume Master). Disable it or reload the tab to use Stream Control volume.

bgNoTab.message: The tab is no longer available or is not a web page.

bgBusyError.message: Could not capture the audio: another extension may be using this tab. The audio was not changed.

bgCaptureStart.message: Could not start audio capture for the tab.

bgActivateFailed.message: Could not activate audio capture. If Volume Master is active on this tab, disable it: two extensions cannot capture the same audio.

noticeNetflix.message: Netflix: experimental and against its ToS.

noticeDisney.message: Disney+: experimental. Choosing a quality reloads the tab.

noticeDisneyNoMaster.message: Master playlist not read: only Auto available.

noticeHbo.message: HBO/Max: experimental. The change may take ~30 s.

noticeTwitch.message: Twitch: experimental. Your choice is remembered after reload.

noticeKick.message: Kick: the ⚙️ menu opens and closes briefly to read the qualities.

noticeKickFail.message: Kick: could not read the menu ($1); only Auto available.

diagFailed.message: Diagnostic: could not use the picker (playback $1, streams $2, video $3).
